title: Ujjain Mahakal Darshan Express
places_covered: Ujjain, Kal Bhairav, Harsiddhi,Mahakaleshwar Temple,Mangal Nath Temple,Navgraha Temple,Sandipani Ashram, Ram Ghat,Ujjain, Kal Bhairav, Harsiddhi,Mahakaleshwar Temple,Mangal Nath Temple,Navgraha Temple,Sandipani Ashram, Ram Ghat

itinerary.details: Arrive in Ujjain and check into your premium 3-Star hotel. After refreshing, meet our spiritual guide who will escort you to the temple. Enjoy VIP fast-track entry for Ujjain Mahakaleshwar darshan. In the evening, walk along the sacred ghats for the holy Aarti ceremony.

Attend the mystical early morning Bhasma Aarti (subject to pre-booking). Participate in a customized Rudrabhishek Puja conducted by our experienced Vedic Pandit. Visit Kal Bhairav temple and Harsiddhi Shaktipeeth before returning to the station for departure.

Arrive in Ujjain and check into your premium hotel. Meet our spiritual guide. Experience VIP fast-track entry for Ujjain Mahakaleshwar darshan. In the evening, witness the breathtaking Shipra River Aarti.
Drive to Omkareshwar, the sacred island shaped like 'Om'. Cross the Narmada River by boat to visit the Jyotirlinga. Perform Mamleshwar Abhishek Puja and explore the ancient Siddhanath Temple.

Visit Harsiddhi Mata Temple (one of the 51 Shaktipeeths) and Kal Bhairav Temple. Complete any pending puja vidhi with our Pandit Ji. In the afternoon, transfer to the railway station/airport for your onward journey.
Arrive in Ujjain, transfer to your hotel. Visit the ancient Avantika Parshwanath Jain Temple, a major pilgrimage site. Enjoy peaceful meditation and evening sandhya aarti.
Travel to Hanumantiya Island, the scenic water reservoir. Enjoy water sports, a boat ride, and scenic views. Return to Ujjain for a peaceful overnight stay.
Explore other prominent Jain temples in and around Ujjain. Savor pure satvik meals. Participate in a spiritual discussion on Jain philosophy with local scholars.
Attend morning prayers. Spend some time shopping for local handicrafts and spiritual books. Checkout and transfer to the airport or railway station for departure.
